L22: # Pigments
L23: 
L24: Profiltra supplies specialised pigment solutions for producers in coatings, inks, and plastics. With in-depth knowledge of pigment chemistry, we support producers in achieving consistent colour quality and reliable performance in their formulations.
L25: 
L26: cite36†Contact us L27: 
L28: cite37†Download brochure L29: ## Specialised pigments for every application
L30: 
L31: A good start is half the work. From printer toners and masterbatch pellets to colourants that meet strict food standards: pigments determine the appearance and appeal of many industrial products. Vibrant colours represent consistent quality and a strong image. In many applications, however, not only colour and appearance are important, but also properties such as lightfastness, weather resistance, and corrosion protection.
L32: Carbon black plays an important role in many applications, while customers today also consider origin and sustainability certifications. Profiltra’s added value lies in our in-depth knowledge of organic pigments, inorganic pigments, and fluorescent pigments. Our experts understand production processes and support in finding a solution that works in practice.
L33: ## Profiltra’s pigment portfolio
L34: 
L35: Profiltra supplies a broad range of pigments for industrial applications such as coatings, inks, paints, and plastics. This includes organic pigments, inorganic pigments, and carbon black. These pigments not only provide colour but also contribute to properties such as opacity, lightfastness, UV resistance, and protection of materials.
L36: Pigments are used in various processes, for example in the production of masterbatch pellets, printing inks, and industrial coatings. Depending on the application, pigments can be supplied as powders or in other processing forms. By collaborating with international producers and partners, Profiltra can supply both standard pigments and custom solutions for different industries.

L67: cite38†Image: Close-up of pigment powders in red, yellow and blue showing particle structure for industrial applications L68: ## Pigments that do more than provide colour
L69: 
L70: Pigments do not only determine the colour of a product but also play an important role in the performance of materials. In applications such as coatings, inks, and plastics, pigments contribute to properties such as lightfastness, UV resistance, and protection of surfaces against external influences. In industrial coatings, pigments can for example contribute to corrosion protection and a longer service life of metal components.
L71: Profiltra supports producers in selecting pigments that match their production process and end application. By combining knowledge of pigment chemistry with insight into formulations, our specialists support companies in achieving consistent colour quality and reliable product performance.

L98: cite34†More news L99: ## Frequently asked questions
L100: 
L101: On this page, we answer several frequently asked questions about pigments and colourants. For a complete overview, please visit our Frequently Asked Questions page. Do you have a specific question or application? Please feel free to contact us for personal advice.
L102: 
L103: cite31†More frequently asked questions L104: #### What are industrial pigments?
L105: 
L106: Industrial pigments are colourants used to give materials colour and to influence certain properties. In addition to appearance, pigments can also provide functional properties such as lightfastness, weather resistance, or corrosion protection.
L107: #### In which applications are pigments used?
L108: 
L109: Pigments are used in a wide range of applications, such as inks, paint, coatings, and plastics. In these products, pigments not only provide colour but can also contribute to protection, durability, and product performance.
L110: #### Which pigment products does Profiltra supply?
L111: 
L112: Profiltra supplies various types of pigments, including organic pigments, inorganic pigments, and fluorescent pigments. In addition, Profiltra supplies carbon black for applications where colour, performance, and material properties play an important role.
L113: #### How does Profiltra support the selection of the right pigments?
L114: 
L115: Profiltra supports customers with technical knowledge of pigments and their applications. Our specialists understand production processes and support in selecting pigments that match the desired colour, properties, and performance of the finished product.
